subject: 429 errors during peak batch job
body: Our production batch pipeline started returning HTTP 429 during our 9am peak. We're sending ~400 requests in a burst every 5 minutes. It worked fine last week. This is blocking our nightly reports from publishing on time.
repro_cmd: echo '429 Too Many Requests — rate limit on key during burst'

subject: Responses cut off mid-stream
body: When we enable streaming, about 10% of responses truncate partway through and the connection drops. Non-streaming calls to the same model complete fine. Started after we moved our gateway behind a new proxy.

subject: 401 after rotating API key
body: We rotated our API key last night per our security policy. Now every request returns 401 Unauthorized. We updated the key in our vault. Production is down.
repro_cmd: echo 'HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized — invalid or missing bearer token'

subject: Which model is cheapest for our classification workload?
body: We run ~2M short classification calls a day. We're on a premium model and our costs jumped. Can you advise on routing to something cheaper without hurting accuracy?

subject: One provider returning 503, others fine
body: Our calls to a specific model are intermittently failing with 503. We don't have fallback configured. This is affecting our customer-facing chatbot during business hours.
repro_cmd: echo 'HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable — upstream provider error'
